name: chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan 5

function.text: CSPG5 is the approved symbol for chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan 5. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in growth factor activity; axon regeneration; cytoskeleton organization.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Ovarian carcinoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CSPG5 have been reported in ovarian carcinoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
